scope: Current 20-PDF website catalogue (19 works; one preserved earlier edition). Observed paths are partial evidence targets, never automatic proof of correct, optimal or deployed application.

papers.title: SUPER ALPHA 1.1
papers.method: Ordered-prefix funding need, voluntary arrangement and qualification before advantage expiry.
papers.applicability: Ordered cash events, disclosed reserves, received financing, stipulated demand and a declared advantage window.
papers.gap: Standalone exact model. Native spend protects current cash, but the whole-plan/deadline screens are not called by the canonical operating path.
papers.next_step: Adapt prefix/deadline checks to prospective native strategy when relevant; do not create spendable forecast funds.

papers.title: OUT-ACCELERATE
papers.method: Compare complementary construction, verification, qualified reuse and fallback on full accepted-outcome time/cost.
papers.applicability: Supplied affine/quadratic tasks, exact arithmetic and stipulated durations/costs.
papers.gap: Seven supplied policies; ordinary workflow ties the best. No measured operating acceleration.
papers.next_step: Measure an applicable workload and complete lifecycle costs before promoting an accelerator.

papers.title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL 1.0
papers.method: Original conditional succession model.
papers.applicability: Original frozen model and edition only.
papers.gap: Superseded research edition retained for provenance; current 1.1 code does not reproduce this edition by implication.
papers.next_step: Use its versioned first-edition release for reproduction; use 1.1 for current constructor claims.

papers.title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL 1.1
papers.method: Synthesize typed observation programs; independently verify target equality and nonidentifiability; compare inherited and conventional construction.
papers.applicability: Supplied linear observation contract; bounded grammar plus rank fallback; exact types and coefficients.
papers.gap: Standalone finite constructor. Conventional 13,566 arithmetic operations beats accumulating 48,141; counts are not monetary costs.
papers.next_step: Keep conventional incumbent; integrate only for applicable accepted tasks with native complete costs and fresh comparisons.

papers.title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL 2026-11-02 Report
papers.pages: All 110 financial summaries and stated evidence boundaries
papers.method: Source-bound synthesis and counterexample/negative-result retention.
papers.applicability: Separately registered cases and exact source; no pooled independent sample.
papers.gap: A report about prior executions, not a runtime mechanism or a new full replay.
papers.next_step: Follow its per-experiment source and audit paths; never pool accounts or infer unexecuted outcomes.

papers.title: Transformational Intelligence
papers.method: Preserve authorized purpose, adjudicate defects, construct missing means and compare unrestricted alternatives.
papers.applicability: Declared finite event-plan language and independent frozen acceptance.
papers.gap: Bounded adjudicated repair exists; instrument_spec explicitly builds no instrument. No general autonomous reformulation or flagship selection optimizer.
papers.next_step: Use real missing-means construction on a consequential candidate; compare the strongest complete alternative.

papers.title: AGI ALPHA foundation
papers.pages: Organizational substrate, validators, settlement and evidence dockets
papers.method: Bounded explicit authority, acceptance-gated settlement and retained capability.
papers.applicability: Current native journal/service contracts and source identities; shared-host checker separation.
papers.gap: Native spending and replay are substantive; the full 198-page architecture is not implemented or certified by these functions.
papers.next_step: Keep native authority/obligations; audit each additional architecture claim at its real call boundary.

papers.title: Invent the Economy
papers.method: Joint means, voluntary outside options, prices, incentives, funding timing and risk.
papers.applicability: Authored finite buyer beliefs, action/price menu and funded current native state.
papers.gap: Existing optional strategic policies rederive decisions; no general invention of market/financing. PR191 original seller only replays a fixed cost-only arm.
papers.next_step: Use observable information, non-entry/staging/pivot and voluntary complete alternatives in a separate prospective seller experiment.

papers.title: The World as an Output
papers.pages: Protected operation language, support criterion and error envelope
papers.method: Construct a nuisance-independent interface preserving repeated future operations.
papers.applicability: Nonnegative structural model, admissible intervention/support and disturbance envelopes.
papers.gap: No corresponding protected-operation compiler identified in the inspected canonical operating path. Named construction hooks do not implement this theorem.
papers.next_step: Construct and independently qualify an interface only when nuisance dependence is the actual bottleneck.

papers.title: Beyond the Production Frontier
papers.pages: Resource cuts, complementary capacity and timing
papers.method: Evaluate complementary capacity/investments, qualification delays and cash/physical constraints.
papers.applicability: Declared finite capacity/sequence model; forecast value separate from spendable cash.
papers.gap: Opt-in finite sequence planning is related machinery, not the paper's physical expansion certificate or installed productive capacity.
papers.next_step: Bind real qualification/resource prerequisites; establish the funded accepted successor against a matched complete route.

papers.title: Beyond the Original Problem
papers.method: Distinguish purpose from inherited intermediate tasks; preserve outputs and future obligations.
papers.applicability: Supplied finite capabilities and event-plan semantics.
papers.gap: Bounded executable reframing and repair do not reproduce the paper's exact study or unrestricted scientific reformulation.
papers.next_step: Test individual and combined changes against unchanged independent acceptance and unrestricted conventional construction.

papers.title: Foundry v2
papers.method: Qualify reusable thermal research infrastructure and a separately commissioned successor.
papers.applicability: Calibration/reset envelopes, separately implemented dynamics and discrepancy challenges.
papers.gap: Original supplied paper is retained; installed thermal execution, independent physical metrology and its exact companion are not established in this operating path.
papers.next_step: Use only for a matching instrument need, with independent uncertainty and successor qualification.

papers.title: Transformational Autonomous Enterprises
papers.method: Reuse compatible generic evidence but check current mission inputs/outputs and grant authority separately.
papers.applicability: Bound source, dependencies, context and evaluator; algebra/backend changes invalidate inheritance.
papers.gap: Source-bound retained procedures exist. This does not reproduce the paper's four-system benchmark or establish lower total cost than direct specialists.
papers.next_step: Bind current mission acceptance and authority; keep a direct specialist/equal-content control.

papers.title: OUT-REFLECT
papers.method: Construct evidence that exposes blind spots with explicit fault domains and scope.
papers.applicability: Categorical adapter assumes at most t distinct source groups are wrong; labels do not prove independence.
papers.gap: Categorical recovery is not the paper's polynomial moment-code construction. Coherent errors outside assumed fault bound can produce a wrong answer.
papers.next_step: Use applicable evidence semantics, independent fault-domain justification and a discriminating external probe.

papers.title: OUT-LEARN
papers.method: Synthesize timing, polarity, weights and joint calibration to reject nuisance with response/error intervals.
papers.applicability: Polynomial drift plus bounded residual, stable gain/floor, no clipping and qualified reversal.
papers.gap: No general gain-calibration/nuisance-cancellation constructor identified in the canonical operating path. Later finite linear foundry is related, not this guarantee.
papers.next_step: Implement only for an actual measurement need; test gain drift, clipping, residuals and complete calibration costs.

papers.title: OUT-THINK
papers.method: Compile a smaller representation preserving answers and update commutation.
papers.applicability: Explicit state/context/question/operation semantics; no secret reads of discarded state.
papers.gap: No canonical encoder/decoder/update-commutation proof implementing this paper identified. Memory retention is not representation equivalence.
papers.next_step: Require answer preservation and operation commutation, including future obligations, before discarding or migrating state.

papers.title: OUT-DESIGN
papers.method: Free usable capacity and check every prepare/qualify/promote/retire-or-restore state.
papers.applicability: Service equivalence, topology, resource vectors, in-flight state and rollback reserve.
papers.gap: Native finance recovery is not the paper's resource/topology transition solver; no general safe-migration construction identified.
papers.next_step: For an actual capacity bottleneck compare consolidation and buying spare capacity; verify intermediate states and no double-use of reserve.

papers.title: OUT-STRATEGISE
papers.method: Choose observations plus one common executable continuation per residual-world leaf.
papers.applicability: Finite permitted world/test/module semantics; costed information and stated interaction assumptions.
papers.gap: Symbolic compose lacks observation branches and residual-world semantics. Expected-value market planning is not minimax common-completion proof.
papers.next_step: For uncertain seller strategy enforce information sets, pay for tests before revelation and compare robust completion/no-test/non-entry.

papers.title: OUT-EXECUTE
papers.method: Reuse complete boundary value profiles with current attaining witnesses and exact equality.
papers.applicability: Complete finite domains, factor ownership/separability and unchanged outside semantics.
papers.gap: Existing exact-input source-bound reuse does not implement arbitrary boundary-profile composition. Reusing a scalar optimum cannot substitute for a complete profile.
papers.next_step: Prefer simpler fixed-input reuse when sufficient; otherwise verify every boundary row/current witness and fail closed on changed semantics.

papers.title: OUT-EVOLVE
papers.method: Earn and qualify reusable means, then test a fresh different successor and stronger discovery separately.
papers.applicability: Qualified applicability and dependency identities; equal-content ordinary reuse and full campaign costs.
papers.gap: Bounded retained procedures are implemented; no demonstrated general inventor improvement or one executed physical/commercial flywheel.
papers.next_step: Freeze before successor; test removal, ordinary reuse and strongest unrestricted specialist with matched access and native costs.
